name: decouple_slice
description: Decouple one feature boundary: the screen's data leaves the server as JSON and the browser builds the markup, so no server-rendered view remains for that flow; behaviour parity.

name: oneshot_decoupling
description: Decouple the whole sample in one run (every case).

name: dummy_file
description: Smoke test: write one file and stop. Proves an agent acts on the checkout at all, without any app work.

name: agent_probe
description:
Probe: read the files it names, derive the values they hold, write one
file, stop. Tests whether an agent converts research into an edit instead
of reading indefinitely.
